crossRefs.note: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
But about the dead, that they are raised; haven’t you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him…
He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,
and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth…
Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of…
But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”

parallels.note: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;
Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Did ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry, he, and they that were with him?
